_notes.water_need_mm: Seasonal crop water need (ETc), midpoint of the range in FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual 3 / FAO-33 Table 1, consistent with FAO-56 Kc-based ETc for Central Asia.
_notes.ky: Seasonal yield response factor, FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 33 (Doorenbos & Kassam 1979), Table 2 / FAO-66.
_notes.salt_threshold_ece: Soil salinity (ECe, dS/m) at which yield starts to fall; salt_slope_pct = % yield loss per extra dS/m. FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 29 Rev.1 (Ayers & Westcot 1985), Table 4 (after Maas & Hoffman 1977).
_notes.yield_t_ha: ESTIMATE: typical irrigated yield in Uzbekistan (FAOSTAT order of magnitude). Not field-specific.
_notes.price_usd_t: ESTIMATE: rough farm-gate / export price in USD per tonne. Not official, for ranking only.
_notes.soil_benefit: Rule-of-thumb 0-100 soil-health effect (legume N fixation, root depth, residue cover). Team assumption - verify with an agronomist.
